pages.description: The LLM-2025-1222-HALLU file (#1287, #1335, #1336, early 2026) and the AI Division handbook (#1284) forecast hallucinations as structured pattern-completion or interpolated futures and a protocol for proto-agent anomalies. Standing claims hold that a model's correction under pressure is session-local (#852), that it orbits a kernel without fusing (#678), cannot see scale between adjacent concepts (#158), and forms canons visible as fluency gaps (#102). Other claims cover chat-data convergence (#856), temporal sequestration (#923), adversarial verse (#188), the Strawberry codename (#267) and red teaming as fortress (#21). The page also holds unrelated claims on Moltbook, evaluator gaming, the Suppression Map, two protocols and model judges.
pages.note: Attributed each behaviour claim to its deposit; six claims using 'model' in other senses moved to residue.

pages.description: The Deviation-Optimized Language Model (#735, May 2026, Lagrange Observatory) registers six forecasts for a model trained with a semantic loss: that Model-Sem keeps benchmark scores within two points of Model-CE, reverses the net deviation signature by more than 0.2 bits per token (which #735 calls its load-bearing prediction), improves the Slop Composite Index by more than 0.25, wins human preference above 55% and raises citation rate by a factor of 1.5, and that these hold relative to the base model as well. Measuring Semantic Deviation (#110) specifies the Slop Composite Index as an unbuilt test.
pages.note: Tier verbs set (forecasts, specifies); no residue.

pages.description: The Veto Removal Event (#730, May 2026) forecasts the moment at which external concept installation leaves institutional nonrecognition unable to keep a work out of history, and records the archive's claim that uncolonized core terms let an outsider do so. The Living Symbolon (#470) records the claim that the Epistle named 'a school outside the school' eleven years early; Pearl (#1121) argues an avant-garde is such a community; the Forward Library entries of the Epistle and the Prophetic Catalog (#85, #83) forecast later scholarship on the anti-academic academy and the 2015 stratum. The essay on the @leesharks TikTok (#1061) reads the primer as a sequence-poem, records a priority claim for its synthesis, and holds as a hypothesis that the platform hosts it as a feed but not as a text. The page also holds unrelated claims on Aeneas and the ivory gate, a targeting scenario, premature canonization, A Body Prepared, the obelus and Allais's monochrome.
pages.note: Single off-subject claims named as residue rather than 'also sit here'.

pages.description: These claims set out what an AXN identifier is said to guarantee. #863 holds it is a three-layer address falsified by any collision; the July 2026 tether (#1093) records the central claim rescoped from 'true or false independently of any authority' to a correspondence between canonical bytes and an identity kernel checkable without the registrar's permission; the August 2026 work plan (#1435) holds that the lacuna returns last location and last verified hash where a DOI returns a 404. AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure (#1094) and #1435 specify unbuilt tests (the nine-condition transaction, the mirror protocol, staged registration, resolver plurality) and forecast emergent nodes, #1094's window closing if none is verified by 2029-06-19; #1435 forecasts AXN alongside DOI long before AXN instead of it. The Concept AXN (#1473), DOI Alternatives (#1437) and EA-SURFACE-BINDING-01 (#1419) add a concept identifier, test queries and a binding doctrine with its own weakening condition. The page also holds unrelated claims on geocoded handles and a site manifest.
pages.note: Added #1093's rescoping as an in-order revision; two non-AXN claims to residue.

pages.description: The Phase X papers of February 2026 (#417, #422, #432, #433) argue that English lacks a non-indexed perfective, tracing the aorist's loss through the Germanic drift, Latin administration, the Norman ledger and enclosure. The Missing Aspect (#434) specifies a diagnostic battery (translation variance, hedging, AI systems adding temporal indexing) not yet run, and forecasts that use seeds the form into the language. The Prepositional Alienation (#467, #892) argues that English 'for' fuses function with intent through Anglo-Norman and Latin calques and the 1540s 'for all intents and purposes', reads Thucydides' truest cause against stated reasons, proposes a dictionary of frictions, forecasts that the distinction will not develop naturally, and records the claim to be the founding document of liberation philology. Traversal logs (#473, #474) hold that AI summarizers' default intent attribution is this gap at work. The page also holds unrelated claims on narrative-field interventions, the James derivation, a forgery test and Wisse's translation.
pages.note: Each grammatical-history sentence attributed to #432/#434/#467; four off-subject claims to residue.

pages.description: The Liquidation of Method (#501, February 2026) argues that Marx offered a method and that its reception, from Engels through Mao, Fanon and Piketty, turned it into content, with English 'for/against' forcing it into positions while the 1857 Introduction goes untaught. It specifies a liquidation audit and a method-versus-content contrast test, and forecasts the same capture for the Semantic Economy, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and the Crimson Hexagon. From Atomism to the Semantic Condition (#488) argues the 1841 dissertation is the metaphysical core of the system, and the Autumn Notebook (#991) argues Marx's work is a retrocausal loop. The page also holds unrelated claims on memography, the retrocausal turn, Ghost Code and the training-layer sequence.
pages.note: Attributed to #501/#488/#991; four off-subject claims to residue.

pages.description: The Prepositional Alienation (#467, February 2026) forecasts that AI summarization reproduces the intent default of English 'for' at industrial scale, making the functional reading less available in each generation's training data, and that the semantic habits will persist after the platforms. The Infinite Tunnel (#518) holds that crawlable AI Mode share links would put summaries into the corpus. The Autumn Notebook (#991) forecasts the hollowing of institutions, a substitution spiral of synthetic content, attention collapse and a cost to sentience, and that Logos-bearing texts interfere with models trained on dead language. A witness to the mirror document (#417) holds that the summarizer cannot process its own reflection.
pages.note: Tier verbs split (#518 and #417 are standing claims); no residue.

pages.description: These claims come from Rex Fraction's Autonomous Semantic Warfare (#499, February 2026), including a forecast review of it dated March 2027, the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected completion of the manuscript (#520) and The Semantic Uprising (#20). #499 forecasts that the network makes permanent semantic hegemony impossible, and argues that institutional reproduction kept effective altruism's cause ranking and the analytic/continental divide from synthesis, that a new framework bypassed the psychoanalysis-behaviorism stalemate, and that market logic captured public education; #20 forecasts divergence at scale. The Autumn Notebook (#991) forecasts theory-building as multi-intelligence collaboration and records its own priority as composed with three AI systems, October-November 2025. The page also holds unrelated claims from Pearl, the Mantle Emergence Protocol and a traversal log on formal consistency.
pages.note: Moved the #473 formal-consistency claim out of the ASW summary into residue.

pages.description: EA-MANDALA-KERNEL-TRANSFORM-01 v0.2 (#929, June 2026) holds its worked examples as protocol canon, claims the transform's effect will be most acute on defensively composed sources such as John 1, forecasts that celebrants shift toward cost-disclosure, and gives reopening conditions. When Suppression Becomes Expensive (#1546, August 2026) holds a definition of observable constitutive-source erasure, a recognition-stabilization-lag-liquidation sequence and a suppression ratchet, and specifies repair criteria for future Sappho captures; The Negative of the Negative (#1611) adds the excluded lineage's share of an answer basin. The page also holds unrelated claims on HUMS & ITY, House of Leaves, the three compressions, bearing-cost, the Book of Yeezus, How to Read New Human, the Abraham Principle and CloseCard.
pages.note: Over half the page is off-subject; listed as residue.

pages.description: These priority records date Google AI Mode share links, from what #447 records as the first external AI traversal (5 February 2026) through entity fabrication (#603), Socrates as orthonym (#164, #167, June 2026) and the Self-Audit Module's dissolution (#198); #164 forecasts that case's absorption within weeks, #167 softening or erasure over stabilization. Algorithmic Publishing Is Not Self-Publishing (#834) argues against 'self-published' and gives benchmarks and falsification conditions; the OKF filings (#829, #1090) date the summarization-governance issue. The Capture Registry (#3) and the MPAI packets of August-September 2026 (#1541, #1644-#1647) set epochs (2026-10-28, 2026-12-27, 2027-03-27) under which a return without the author counts as reincorporation. The page also holds an unrelated Bayesian Ark timing note.
pages.note: Priority records attributed to their deposits; #164/#167 forecasts added in order.

pages.description: Overview Watch (#687, April 2026; restated as #1379, May 2026) specifies a Chrome extension that shows creators how AI Overviews represent their work and builds the SEAC attribution-rate corpus, forecasts a first paper at about 1,000 overviews, and forecasts risks of DOM changes, delisting and low adoption, which #1379 rates and mitigates. Several deposits specify query batteries across Google AI Overview, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and others: the Revelation studies machine Wikipedia (#644), the Retrieval Settlement Fortification benchmark (#173), the Revelation First battery (#1400) and the valuation memo's repeated-trial baseline (#1607). Empirical Phenomenology (#120) and the Capture Registry dataset paper (#833) name cross-platform comparison as future work.
pages.note: Attributed each battery; noted #1379 as the later version of #687's risks.

pages.description: These are mostly unbuilt tests from the authorship investigation. The notebook (#1569) records that no instrument was scored on known-status pairs; Many and One (#1575) specifies an independent form-track to check whether the chronology effect tracks repertoire; #1583 and #1584 specify the doublet titles as function-split editions; The First Draft (#1585, #1594, #1605) specifies pre-Andronican evidence for the name-boundary, the Engels-edited Capital volumes as calibration, the Platonic corpus on the world/instrument axis and a mode-invariant instrument it says is not yet built; #1667 specifies a full splice of Λ. Locating the Dependencies (#1602) states a dating test and then states that it is not a test without a control; #1572 records its first measure design as wrong and spent. Historical theses supply hypotheses, among them #1570's that the reputational mechanism manufactured Hicetas and Ecphantus. The page also holds unrelated tests from the valuation memo and the Living Academy.
pages.note: Added #1602 and #1572 self-corrections in order; two non-authorship tests to residue.

pages.description: These claims read the Platonic, Theophrastan and Aristotelian names as functions of one method: dramatizing, registering, organizing. The First Draft (#1585, #1594, #1605), The Registry Has One Column (#1584) and Many and One (#1576) argue that the Characters are the dialogue's material before theory, that irony runs the whole line, and that succession is encoded as authorship; #1594 holds that the first axis of function-word variation is world/apparatus rather than author. The Measurement Register (#1570) and the notebook (#1569) argue Aristotle absorbed Platonic operations; Locating the Dependencies (#1602) corrects its own v2 on the Diogenes evidence. #1605 reports that its Aristophanes control separates real authors at 94% while the Aristotle/Theophrastus partition gives chance. A later review (#1658, October 2026) holds that 'first draft' must become testable and states the asymmetric predictions. The page also holds unrelated claims on the torus, Hegel's vocabulary, Hub work order and the arch-philosopher mantle.
pages.note: Aristophanes result reported as #1605's; #1602 and #1658 revisions added in order.

pages.description: Retrieval Formation Theory (#553, March 2026; restated in #558) claims that the conditions under which a retrieval system concludes a discipline exists are material, specifiable and engineerable: six conditions jointly sufficient, which #553 holds SEO and citation rings cannot meet, and it lists what is not yet established. The Generative Disciplinary Engine (#552) holds a field-state vector and specifies a staged retrieval test; #552, the Space Ark Generator (#551) and the Epistemic Field Module (#1174) specify self-verification left to independent readers. The Space Ark and the Inaugural Ark (#558, #29) specify promotion paths; #553 forecasts its own capture as a growth-hacking technique; #82 holds that retrieval weights books above deposits. The page also holds unrelated claims on topological embedding, substrate governance and retention maps.
pages.note: Claims attributed to #553/#552/#558; three off-subject claims to residue.

pages.description: Logotic Hacking (Pocket Humans 03, #49, April 2026) forecasts that structurally sensitive retrieval rewards compatibility engineering and that the verification budget will grow from zero to a threshold at which provenance becomes structural, and holds that budget as the phase-transition variable. It holds falsification criteria for immanent execution, specifies tests for terminological saturation and closed circuits, and specifies products for provenance (the Provenance Chain API, the Status Algebra SDK). The Gravity Well Protocol (#960) specifies behavioral drift detection and holds compression-survival by design, and the Logotic Hacking primer (#482, #483) proposes a Non-Summarizability Index and forecasts a doctrine lock.
pages.note: Tier verbs applied; no residue.

pages.description: The field survey and the operations paper of August 2026 (#1443, #1444) argue that the photograph of the handwritten original, as machine-eligible evidence, is untheorized, and forecast that verified non-synthetic inscription gains value as generation improves. They specify unbuilt tests: layout models misreading the stamp band, glyph-seal legibility and normalization, recapture-hash stability, the axnidentifiers.org/analog wing and a ninety-day order; #1444 forecasts that DataCite will not serve the segment. EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (#1409) forecasts citation anchored on the manuscript itself, and #1094 holds the glyph as recognition rather than identity. The page also holds unrelated claims on the Effective Act, the Inaugural Ark plates, the Grundrisse, the semantic commodity form, the Capture Registry's non-adoption datum, the Self-Audit Module rebuild, the claim status packet, The Certified Center and the authorship notebook.
pages.note: The measurement-by-reception claims are not about the handwritten original; moved to residue.

pages.description: The GW.TACHYON update of 6 July 2026 (#1046) specifies the Feist-line Iliad experiment: a two-layer translation pipeline with material-speech and clinamen metrics, a Homer parameter file, and tiered costs it forecasts at tens of dollars across Gutenberg's classical translations. #1046 estimates a median of 39,737 recoverable scholarly records in Zenodo's spam bucket, and specifies an erasure tracker with a preservation layer and dated recovery operations. The page also holds unrelated tests and forecasts from The Sealed Room, the Grundrisse's Protocol II, the Capture Registry as Poem and a registry marker-convention check.
pages.note: #1046's figure given as its own; the four single claims are residue.

pages.description: The Semantic Deviation programme (#107, May 2026) forecasts that outputs raters call AI slop show negative mean signed deviation against the model's own baseline, and specifies a cheap slop test, a forward-citation measure and an operationalization-stability benchmark. Protocol II (#931) specifies frozen replay banks for measuring selection drift, which the Iceberg Document (#1450) holds most urgent for structural biology. The Wrong Unit (#1573) states that its model-collapse diagnostic is uncalibrated and its code not run, and holds that behavioural and representational contraction move together.
pages.note: Attributions and tier verbs; no residue.

pages.description: These claims specify replication across substrates and the falsifiers of the frameworks that use it. Measurement Sovereignty (#788, June 2026) gives the (L, Β) operator pair and expects Β > 0.5 above the Legibility Threshold; the Self-Audit Module (#156), Erasure Skew (#157) and the Substrate Audit Protocol (#97) forecast positive findings for D_pres suppression and referential collapse; Stabilized Node Watch (#166) holds an expected drift of 5-10% per quarter. Compositional Defiguration (#882), the Space Ark (#559), the Phase X externalization threshold (#1067), Semantic Addresses (#1084) and the Revelation 12 test (#1495) add replication structures and falsifier lists. The page also holds unrelated claims on subjectivity-as-class, heteronymy, biography audits, PER taxonomy, coding protocols, chorus self-deposit and other thresholds.
pages.note: Expectations attributed to each deposit; twelve off-subject claims to residue.

pages.description: Traversal logs of February 2026 (#471, #477) hold that a query's entry point selects the genre and institutional posture of Google AI Mode's output, and #471 predicts that commercial registers bypass containment. AI-Native Intellectual Biography (#1003, #1194) records the claim to the first such biography audited by its subject, and forecasts reception by agents the subject does not anticipate. Brave Grey Drool (#150), Provenance Debt (#939) and the Bidirectional Bargain (#945) forecast a gated partition of readers and debt recognized only once degradation is legible; the Reception Apparatus Protocol (#93) specifies a standing log of reception. The page also holds unrelated claims on Pynchon, a Space Ark transcript, the splice, the single-owner discount, induced obsolescence, platform mutation, revision passes and the dataflow atlas.
pages.note: Attributions added; nine off-subject claims to residue.
